name: Merciless Repurposing
oracle_text: Exile target creature. Incubate 3. (Create an Incubator token with three +1/+1 counters on it and "{2}: Transform this token." It transforms into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.)

rulings.comment: If the target of Merciless Repurposing is illegal as the spell tries to resolve, it won't resolve and none of its effects will happen. You won't incubate.
